text:
Macklin Celebrini is 20, the Sharks' captain, and the reason anyone circles San Jose games now. He has 31 points in 24 games at 23 minutes a night, 13 of them on the power play, and the team's share of expected goals is 11 points better with him on the ice than off it. Few players anywhere move that number so far.

There's no luck story to pick apart. He has 10 goals on 11.0 expected, so the finishing is, if anything, a touch behind. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) puts his primary shot assists at the 99th percentile among forwards: the next shot is usually a teammate's, and that's where assists come from. He's also tied for second in the league in penalties drawn. Evolving-Hockey had him 12th among forwards in wins above replacement last season, at 19. Our range projects 97 to 127 points. Watch him with Ivar Stenberg, the rookie who has grown into his wing.
